drafts.note: v3 of the situation-level text (14 Sep 2026, the lead), from the replay of v2 on run 12's 89 dossiers whose kind carries several situations: 44 right, 23 wrong, 22 declines (49 %). The judge's own reasons showed three causes. (1) Fifteen coursework declines were readings and handouts -- textbook pages, articles, worksheets, study texts -- struck because no institution issued them: v2's lines say 'record' and the judge read it as an official document. v3 says a situation's files are what the person was given, made, was issued and sent in it, that a line's examples are a list not a fence, and that 'record' means belonging, not issuance. (2) Eight coursework files went to the instructor's side or the institution's records about a child because a teacher authored them: v2 forbade reasoning about the person, which forbade the one question that separates those siblings. v3 keeps the ban on guessing who the person is and requires reasoning about the file's relation to them -- given to, made by, issued about, sent by -- and says material handed to the person is the person's side. (3) Four resumes went to portfolio because that line's purpose-word ('framed to be shown') captured a document the recruiting line names outright: v3 says a document one line names by kind is that line's, and that a special case of the ordinary piece of work is answered only on its distinguishing mark. Everything else byte-identical to v2.
